results.excerpt: Refund Policy. A refund can be requested only for orders whose status is completed. Orders with status cancelled were never charged, so no refund applies to them. If a completed order is delivered in more than 45 minutes, the customer receives a full refund of the order amount. If a completed order is delivered in 45 minutes or less, no late-delivery refund is paid. Refunds up to INR 1000 are approved automatically by the support system. A refund above INR 1000 must be approved by a human support lead before money is returned. Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5 working days. A refund request must be raised within 7 days of the delivery date.

Delivery Policy. Standard delivery is promised within 30 minutes of order confirmation in all supported cities. The supported cities are Chennai, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi, Hyderabad and Pune. A delivery fee of INR 25 is charged on orders below INR 199, and delivery is free on orders of INR 199 or more. During heavy rain the promised time may extend to 60 minutes and the app shows a rain notice. A rider will attempt to contact the customer twice before marking an order as undeliverable. Electronics items are delivered only after the customer shares a one time password with the rider.

Payment Policy. Customers can pay using UPI, debit card, credit card or cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is available only for orders up to INR 2500. If a payment fails but money is deducted, the amount is returned automatically within 48 hours. A customer who sees two charges for one order should raise a billing ticket with the order identifier. Wallet balance can be used for any order and is never refunded as cash. Coupons cannot be combined with wallet balance on the same order.
